endScript:
mkdir -p /home/ubuntu/Desktop
chown ubuntu:ubuntu /home/ubuntu/Desktop
cd /home/ubuntu/Desktop
git clone https://github.com/devashish234073/cloud-pc-templates-marketplace
ln -s /home/ubuntu/Desktop/cloud-pc-templates-marketplace/JS-AGENTS /home/ubuntu/Desktop/JS-AGENTS
chown -R ubuntu:ubuntu /home/ubuntu/Desktop/cloud-pc-templates-marketplace
chown -h ubuntu:ubuntu /home/ubuntu/Desktop/JS-AGENTS
echo '[Desktop Entry]\nVersion=1.0\nType=Link\nName=Cloud PC Templates\nURL=http://cloud-pc-templates.com\nIcon=text-html' > /home/ubuntu/Desktop/cloud-pc-templates.desktop
chmod +x /home/ubuntu/Desktop/cloud-pc-templates.desktop
chown ubuntu:ubuntu /home/ubuntu/Desktop/cloud-pc-templates.desktop
cd /home/ubuntu/Desktop/JS-AGENTS
for file in *.js; do [ -f "$file" ] && echo "Starting: $file" && node "$file" &; done
